title: Per-stage configuration values
description: Committed file `config/<target>/<stage>.json` (local: `config/local.json`). Owner: CFG. Behavior: docs/components/config.md. Secret values never appear here.

values.description: Values for the keys the app declares. Keys with defaults may be omitted; keys not declared by the app are rejected.

admins.description: User IDs of admins, as shown by /api/auth/me.

publicOrigin.description: Public origin of the stage, e.g. https://notes.example.com. If omitted on a cloud target, the generated URL from provisioning is used.

google.description: Google login client settings. Required for production deployments.

testStage.description: Marks the stage as a test stage (authentication mock present, SYS-REQ-020).
